mapper.sql: select id, name, no, product_code, type, source, price_detail, status, description, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted from crm_model_product
mapper.select: where deleted = 0 and status = 1 and (product_code = #{productCode} or ((product_code is null or product_code = '') and no = #{productCode})) order by id limit 1

select a.id, a.name, a.no, a.product_code, a.type, a.source, a.price_detail, a.status, a.description, e.user_name as creator, a.create_time, c.user_name as updater, a.update_time from crm_model_product a left join sys_user c on a.updater = c.user_id left join sys_user e on a.creator = e.user_id
a.deleted = 0 and a.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and a.no like concat('%', #{no}, '%') and a.type = #{type} and a.source = #{source} and a.price_detail like concat('%', #{priceDetail}, '%') and a.status = #{status} and a.description like concat('%', #{description}, '%') and a.creator = #{creator} and a.updater = #{updater}
and a.create_time >= str_to_date(concat(#{params.beginTime}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and a.create_time <= str_to_date(concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
order by a.id desc

mapper.select: select p.id, p.name, p.no, p.product_code, p.type, p.source, p.price_detail, p.status, p.description, agg.min_cost_discount, agg.max_cost_discount, agg.min_sell_discount, agg.max_sell_discount from ( select supplier_id, project_id, min(min_cost_discount) as min_cost_discount, max(max_cost_discount) as max_cost_discount, min(min_sell_discount) as min_sell_discount, max(max_sell_discount) as max_sell_discount from crm_supplier_project where supplier_id = #{supplierId} group by supplier_id, project_id ) agg inner join crm_model_product p on agg.project_id = p.id where p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 order by p.id
